# DataGrid

## Purpose and role

A spreadsheet-like grid with a cell cursor, editing and pending changes.

Role: `grid`.

## Keyboard

| Key (Desktop) | Key (Vim) | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `↑↓←→` | `↑↓←→` | Cell |
| `Enter F2` | `Enter F2` | Edit |
| `Delete` `Backspace` | `Delete` `Backspace` | Clear cell |
| `-` | `-` | Mark for deletion |
| `+` | `+` | Insert row |
| `Ctrl+D` `Alt+D` | `Ctrl+D` `Alt+D` | Duplicate row |
| `y` | `y` | Copy |
| `Y` | `Y` | Copy with header |
| `Ctrl+S` | `Ctrl+S` | Save |
| `s` | `s` | Sort |
| `S` | `S` | Clear sort |
| `f` | `f` | Filter on cell |
| `/` | `/` | Filters |
| `F` | `F` | Clear filters |
| `r` `F5` | `r` `F5` | Refresh |
| `u` | `u` | Undo |
| `U` | `U` | Discard |
| `p` | `p` | Preview SQL |
| `Ctrl+]` | `Ctrl+]` | Follow reference |
| `Ctrl+A` | `Ctrl+A` | Select all |

## Mouse

| Target | Click | Double click | Secondary click | Drag | Wheel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| cell | moves the cell cursor | edits an editable cell | moves the cursor, opens the cell menu | extends the cell range | scrolls the rows |
| scrollbar | pages toward the click (`TrackClick::Page`) | — | — | the thumb scrolls | scrolls |

## Hints by state

| State | Desktop | Vim |
|---|---|---|
| focused, no rows | `↑↓←→` Cell · `y` Copy | `↑↓←→` Cell · `y` Copy |

## Knobs

| Knob | Default | Layer | Standard |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keymap` | the command enum's `default_keymap()` | key map | WCAG 2.1.4 (remappable) |
| `click` | `ClickPolicy::DATA`: one click selects, a double click activates | widget | macOS lists (SI14) |
| `editable` | on | widget | APG grid |

## Keyboard-only path

- Cell: `↑↓←→`
- Edit: `Enter F2`
- Clear cell: `Delete` `Backspace`
- Mark for deletion: `-`
- Insert row: `+`
- Duplicate row: `Ctrl+D` `Alt+D`
- Copy: `y`
- Copy with header: `Y`
- Save: `Ctrl+S`
- Sort: `s`
- Clear sort: `S`
- Filter on cell: `f`
- Filters: `/`
- Clear filters: `F`
- Refresh: `r` `F5`
- Undo: `u`
- Discard: `U`
- Preview SQL: `p`
- Follow reference: `Ctrl+]`
- Select all: `Ctrl+A`

## Mouse-first path

- cell: click moves the cell cursor; double click edits an editable cell; wheel scrolls the rows.
- scrollbar: click pages toward the click (`TrackClick::Page`); double click —; wheel scrolls.
